annotation.description: A fight video of 2 boxers in a ring and a refree. The two fighting boys wear a black and a red short. The referee a white-black-striped tshirt and black yeans. You can see a black fence in the foreground so the video is taped from behind that fence. Both boys wear boxing gloves. There is a public audience in the back. You can read Northwest Fighting.com in the bottom right corner of the video. The floor of the fighting area is red.
